# ASSIGNMENTOFRENTS ASSIGNMENT,made as of the 1stdayof May,2005,byDEECEE ASSOCIATES, LLC. a New York limited liability company with offices at 2130 Broadway, Suite 203, New York, New York 10023, Assignor to M&T REAL ESTATE TRUST, successor in interest by merger to M&T Real Estate,Inc.,a Maryland real estate investment trust having an office at 1 Fountain Plaza,9th Floor,Buffalo,NewYork 14203,Assignee. RECITALS The Assignor is the owner in fee of the premises set forth in Schedule A (the “Mortgaged Property") and has requested the Assignee to modify the existing Mortgage in the sum of $1,365,054.58. The Assignee has refused to modify the loan unless the Assignor, in addition to executing executing and delivering such instruments in order to secure the loan by a first mortgage lien, in like amount, on the Mortgaged Property (all of the above documents are hereinafter referred to as the“LoanDocuments"),alsoexecutes and delivers this Assignment of Rents as additional collateral for the repayment of the loan in the amount of $1,365.054.58.
